reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates pass: (1) accrue_interest has 8+ non-test callers in market.move; (2) no trust_assumptions table in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json — gate 2 inapplicable; (3) reserve.move is explicitly in scope. Code confirms the bug at market.move:1025 — asset.repay_fee_rate() is passed as the reserve_factor argument to reserve.accrue_interest(), causing cash_reserve to grow unboundedly on every interest accrual. An attacker can trigger this via normal market interaction (borrow/repay/deposit/withdraw) by driving utilization high over time, causing cash_reserve to exceed cash, util_rate to exceed 100%, and all subsequent borrow and withdrawal transactions to revert, freezing the market. Severity retained at Medium: full impact requires either max repay_fee_rate configuration (admin-set) or sustained high utilization over days.
